bills.title: Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Amendment (Improving Safety) Bill 2019

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2020-02-11.3.2) intrdouced by Gippsland MP [Darren Chester](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/gippsland/darren_chester) (Nationals), which means it passed. The motion was: > *That the second reading be made an order of the day for the next sitting.* A [second reading](https://www.peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/) is a vote to agree with the main idea of the bill.
